meta.description: Perform bounded, local exploratory analysis of explicitly supported scientific files. Use for redacted CSV/TSV/JSON profiles; optional NumPy, HDF5, FASTA/FASTQ, and basic image metadata inspection; missingness/leakage audits; outlier and transformation sensitivity; and rigorous EDA report scaffolds. Other domain formats are reference-only and unknown formats fail closed.

scientific_integrity.detail: Outstanding methodological discipline with explicit warnings against causal claims from EDA, clear boundary between exploratory and confirmatory analysis, and comprehensive statistical rigor requirements

practice_boundaries.detail: Exceptional scope definition: does not certify files, infer scientific meaning, or support every format; clear fail-closed policy for unknown formats

methodological_ground.detail: Based on established statistical practices (NIST EDA handbook, FDA E9(R1), EPA detection limits, scikit-learn leakage guidance) with authoritative source citations

code_usability.detail: All code examples are syntactically correct with comprehensive security boundaries and safe I/O patterns

functional_suitability.note: Comprehensive coverage with exact capability matrix, automated core (CSV/TSV/JSON), optional formats (NPY/HDF5/FASTA/image), reference-only domain formats, and fail-closed policy

reliability.note: Exceptional reliability with 8-point safe I/O contract, bounded execution guarantees, atomic outputs, and explicit output interpretation guidance

performance_context.note: Well-organized documentation (280 lines) with capability matrix, 6 domain-specific reference files, and workflow structure

agent_usability.note: Outstanding with exact capability matrix, 10-rule EDA reasoning framework, workflow steps, and clear reference selection guidance ('Do not load every reference')

human_usability.note: Clear installation for optional capabilities only; workflow with authorization confirmation; bundled scripts with --root pattern; report scaffold generator

security.note: Exceptional security: comprehensive untrusted data warnings, safe I/O contract rejecting URLs/symlinks/special files, no pickle/eval/macros, bounded reads, identifier redaction, fail-closed policy

maintainability.note: Excellent structure with version 1.1, clear license (MIT), 6 comprehensive references, version baseline (verified 2026-07-23), pinned dependencies with publication dates, and authoritative source citations

agent_specific.note: Strong composability with allowed-tools including Glob; capability_manifest.py for format detection; deterministic outputs; minor: specific output schemas for JSON reports not fully detailed
